candidates.change_summary: Removed the non-reentrancy guard by deleting the locking require and assignments, leaving modifier that does nothing (so Put no longer protected).
Changed assignment of unlockTime to always use the provided _unlockTime (even if in the past), making Put set acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime unconditionally.
Set unlockTime to always be block.timestamp regardless of input, so Put resets unlockTime to now.
Replace the external call to msg.sender with a transfer to msg.sender using transfer (which reverts on failure), changing success-path behavior and effects on balance/logging.
Change the conditional to require block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime instead of >, allowing collects at exact unlock time and altering when Collect succeeds.
Remove the check that acc.balance>=MinSum so Collect can succeed even for balances below MinSum, changing observable ability to withdraw.
Remove the lock setting before execution so reentrancy guard no longer prevents reentrant entry (only unlock after), changing reentrancy-surface behavior.
